name: learn-kit
description: The learning graph, levels, schedule, drills and learner profile shared by Lampas and Kestrel, as small framework-free libraries: @learn-kit/graph (nodes and needs, order, levels and a store, the frontier and the review schedule), @learn-kit/drill (the drill walk, forms, a sitting's mix and the placement), @learn-kit/learner (the learner profile, a goal and its scaffolding) and @learn-kit/recall (saying a text from memory: fold, the words of a text, matching what was said against a target, and which words a rung hides).

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/graph/tsconfig.build.json packages/drill/tsconfig.build.json packages/fresh/tsconfig.build.json packages/learner/tsconfig.build.json packages/recall/tsconfig.build.json
